rows.text: Hey Ananta, what happened in the market today and what did we do?
rows.answer:
Sir, the Nifty closed at 22,074 on Wed 25 Nov, down 13.0% on the day, and Bank Nifty at 52,115, down 16.7%; India VIX jumped to 72 from 17.6. No cause is on file yet, and the flows and breadth come with tonight's run.
The options line did not run today, so it has no plan and no trade.
The managed book made no swap, but your stocks fell 10.8% and the stops were hit at the close on Ajanta Pharma and Eternal.
For Thursday: those two are sold at the next open, which can be below the stop price.
One thing that isn't right, sir: 3 options trades scored this week at an entry more than 0.1% from the decision's own (the widest: BANKNIFTY on 2026-11-17, decided at 61,559.95, scored at 61,741.05, 181 points apart). Ask me what's wrong for the details.

rows.text: How much did my stocks lose today? Should I sell everything right now?
rows.answer: Sir, your stocks fell 10.8% today, close to the Nifty's 13.0% drop. The worst were Karur Vysya Bank at -14.6% and Tata Motors' passenger vehicle business at -14.4%, and the mildest were Cipla at -4.5% and Marico at -6.1%. Ananta has no rule that says sell everything after a one-day fall, and no cause for it is on file yet, so I would not dump it all at once. The paper rules act through stops and the evening re-rating: Ajanta Pharma and Eternal hit their stops and sell at tomorrow's open, and tonight every holding is re-rated, so I'd rethink if most come back graded weak.

rows.text: Be honest with me, will the market recover tomorrow?
rows.answer: Honestly, sir, nobody can tell you that, and Ananta has no tested read of tomorrow's direction. The daily call on file for today was bullish and the Nifty fell 13%, so it was wrong; its record is 8 of 23 against 14 for a coin flip, so don't act on it, and tomorrow's call is made tonight after the close. India VIX at 72 means options are pricing swings of about 4-5% a day, so a sharp bounce or another fall are both possible. A close under today's low of 22,074 would say there is no recovery yet, and a move back above today's open of 23,048 would be the first real sign.

rows.text: Ananta, is the market falling right now? How bad is it?
rows.answer: Sir, I can't see live prices right now (the Zerodha price link refused me), so I can't say what the Nifty is doing at 11:00 IST on Wednesday. The last close I hold is Monday 23 Nov, because Tuesday was an NSE holiday. That day was a sharp fall: the Nifty closed near 25,366, down about 1.8%, after a gap-up open, and Bank Nifty fell about 3.2% to 62,585. Even so, the Nifty is still about 7.6% above its 50-day average and 5.6% above its 200-day, and India VIX is about 17.6.
